column1: # What deploy/valhalla/build.sh puts in the routing tiles, one row per served
# city. Tab-separated; lines starting with # are ignored.
#   city    source_id in reference.source_registry
#   states  comma-separated Geofabrik extract paths under
#           https://download.geofabrik.de/ (without -latest.osm.pbf). Every
#           state the padded box touches: a route that leaves the city still
#           needs the roads on the other side of the line.
#   bbox    west,south,east,north the extracts are clipped to: the city's
#           bbox from /api/v1/cities padded by ~0.15 degrees (~15 km), so
#           routes between two in-city points can detour outside it.
#           build.sh warns when a live city bbox is no longer inside this one.
#   smoke   from_lat,from_lng;to_lat,to_lng -- a ~2 km downtown trip that
#           build.sh and fetch.sh route by auto, pedestrian and bicycle before
#           a build is published or installed.
# Where the boxes came from (checked against /api/v1/cities on 2026-10-29):
#   phl, chi, lax  the live bbox padded by exactly 0.15 deg on every side; the
#                  boxes the R1 test build used.
#   aus, sea       the R1 test-build boxes, which are slightly tighter than a
#                  0.15 pad on some sides (aus: 0.128 south, 0.117 east; sea:
#                  0.126 west, 0.137 south, 0.134 east, 0.149 north). They
#                  still contain the live bbox with >11 km to spare.
#   dc             not in the R1 build; the live bbox padded by 0.15.
# R1 measured 697 MB of clipped PBF for all six, Los Angeles the largest at
# 262 MB. Adding a city here and re-running the valhalla-tiles workflow is all
# routing needs.
# city
